name: Fried Mozzarella Stick Dip

ingredients.name: shredded whole milk low-moisture mozzarella cheese
packages full-fat cream cheese, cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions.primary_message: For the Dip: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 205°C (400°F).

In a large bowl, stir mozzarella and cream cheese to evenly combine. Scrape mixture into an 8-by-20-cm baking dish. Using an offset spatula, smooth surface into an even layer. Add marinara sauce and tilt pan from side to side to evenly distribute.
Bake until lightly browned around the edges, bubbling slightly, and molten in the center, 20 to 25 minutes.

Meanwhile, Prepare the Topping: In a medium skillet over medium heat, melt butter. Add panko, stirring to evenly coat with butter, and cook, stirring constantly, until golden brown and toasted, 4 to 5 minutes. Add Italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt, and pepper, and mix to combine. Transfer to a plate; let cool slightly.
Scatter panko mixture all over surface of dip and garnish with torn basil leaves. Serve immediately with crusty bread.

schema_metadata.keywords: fried mozzarella sticks, mozzarella stick dip, cheese dip, cheese dip recipe

description: No broken shells, no runaway cheese—just a creamy, scoopable version of the classic appetizer.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Fresh basil leaves, to garnish (optional); Crusty bread, for serving

Make-ahead and storage: The breadcrumb topping can be prepared up to 3 days in advance and stored in an airtight container at room temperature.
The dip can be assembled in the baking dish and refrigerated up to 1 day in advance. If baking straight from the fridge, add 10 minutes to the total baking time. Scatter with breadcrumbs and basil just before serving. Leftover dip can be kept in its baking dish, wrapped in plastic wrap or foil or covered with a lid, and refrigerated for up to 3 days. To serve, reheat in a 175°C (350°F) oven until warmed through.
author: Laura Manzano
